richiami.difetto: A specific batch of Marangoni 165 R13 M500 tyres may experience pressure loss due to cracking at the join of the tread and sidewall.
richiami.rimedio: The importer has written to all end users of the subject tyres advising them to take their vehicle back to the supplier to have the tyre inspected. Any tyres found to belong to the suspect batch will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: TYRE CRACKING AT JOIN OF TREAD AND SIDEWALL
